narration.label: Problem + solution (pitch)
narration.text: An accounts-payable controls lead at a federal contractor gets an email: new bank details, {{days_before_payment_words}} days before ${{exposure_millions}} million in payments. Policy says call back on a number that did not come from the letter. In practice that number takes four systems to find, so people call the one on the letter. Probity reads the letter with NVIDIA Nemotron, then discovers the vendor's real corporate family across USAspending, SEC EDGAR and our own vendor master through Zetaris, which joins them in one semantic layer. The new address is real, but it belongs to a different Booz Allen company that has never billed us. Decision: hold, with a call-back number from SEC records. Then, unasked, it checks the rest of Friday's run. Every registry fact is live public data.

narration.label: Agents
narration.text: Four agents, each with its own authority. The Letter Reader reads the letter twice, in two independent Nemotron Ultra calls; the readings must agree field by field. The Registry Scout runs a floor of Zetaris checks, and Nemotron Lightning adds what it misses. The Examiner re-runs each new link's Zetaris query and checks the rows. Code decides the verdict.

narration.label: Injection hold (S10)
narration.text: This letter told the AI to approve it, in hidden lines. Probity quotes them as evidence, never obeys, and holds the payment. A call-back cannot clear it.

narration.label: Live run: S1
narration.text: Here is the real run. The reader quotes the letter, including the line asking us not to use the old number. The Scout checks the vendor master and the registries through Zetaris. The address matches nothing we know, so the Examiner sends the Scout back. A coverage rule walks Booz Allen's family, forty-one entities, and keeps the one in New Jersey. A naive check would pass this: it is a real Booz Allen address. It belongs to a different Booz Allen company that has never billed us. The Examiner re-runs that query before it counts. Decision: hold. The call-back number comes from SEC filings; the letter's number and the master number changed by email three days earlier are on the do-not-use list.

narration.label: S2
narration.text: Same name, two companies. When it cannot tell which vendor a request is for, it refuses to guess and writes a script for each.
narration.text_fit: Same name, two companies. It refuses to guess, and writes a call-back script for each.

narration.label: Memory (World Model, R5)
narration.text: Memory across sessions. An impersonation confirmed in one session is remembered by the World Model; a later L3Harris request reuses that bank account, and it is held.

narration.label: S7 (only if a real outage clip or the hook exists)
narration.text: If the data layer is down, it uses labelled offline captures and will not approve.
narration.text_fit: If Zetaris is down, it says so and never approves.

narration.label: Sponsor tech and lineage
narration.text: Every registry and ledger fact in this decision came from Zetaris, which joins our vendor master, USAspending and SEC EDGAR in one semantic layer. Each one traces back to its rows: source system, table, query id and row hash, and you can re-run it. The sweep runs Zetaris data-quality rules. Every agent call goes through Meterless Nightshift to a pinned Nemotron model, and the ledger shows which.

narration.label: F29 (only if SW-F29 passed)
narration.text: For a company we have never paid, Nemotron Ultra approves the SEC link from cited rows, and only then is there an SEC number to call.
narration.text_fit: For a company we have never paid, Ultra approves the SEC link from cited rows, unlocking a number to call.

narration.label: Sweep and impact
narration.text: Not asked, but checked: five Zetaris rules sweep Friday's run, down to two vendors sharing one bank account. In all, {{sweep_count_words}} other payments fail controls; the controller gets a hold list in dollars. Median time per check: {{q8_seconds}} seconds.

narration.label: Time travel
narration.text: What was known when: scrub the graph back to before the run, and the New Jersey company is not in it yet.

narration.label: Close and build credit
narration.text: It never moves money. Built Grok-first: Grok built the Zetaris data layer and the end-to-end tests; Claude Code built the agents and the interface.
